name: brave_search
description: Queries the Brave Search REST API for privacy-first web results with titles, URLs, snippets and freshness filters, plus an optional AI summarizer key.

query.description: The web search query (e.g. 'model context protocol spec')

count.description: Number of results to return (1-20, default 5)

country.description: Two-letter country code used to localise results (default 'US')

search_lang.description: Language code for the returned results (default 'en')

freshness.description: Restrict results by age: 'pd' (24h), 'pw' (7d), 'pm' (31d), 'py' (1y) or a range like '2024-01-01to2024-06-30'

summary.description: Request an AI summarizer key alongside the results. Requires a Brave plan that includes the Summarizer (default false).

api_key.description: Brave Search subscription token. Reads BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY (or BRAVE_API_KEY) env var if omitted.
